verdict.rationale: Algolia documents all three surfaces needed for an agent to do end-to-end index/document/query workflows without a dashboard: REST API for search/indexing/records (algolia-docs-4, algolia-docs-31), a full-featured CLI with auth and app selection (algolia-docs-2, algolia-docs-30, algolia-docs-19), and an official MCP server plus agent skills package covering CLI, MCP, crawler, and migrations (algolia-docs-17, algolia-docs-50, algolia-docs-60, algolia-probe-4). Docs explicitly call out AI-agent workflows ('Are you building with AI agents? ... Build with AI', algolia-docs-57). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually completing create-index-to-query flow via CLI/MCP without touching a dashboard, and explicit confirmation the MCP server exposes write/index-creation operations rather than just search/analytics/recommendations.
